title: Influence of Co(III) Polypyridyl Complexes on Luminescence Behavior, DNA Binding, Photocleavage, Antimicrobial Activity and Molecular Docking Studies.
authors: Perka, Shyam; Vuradi, Ravi Kumar; Gopu, Srinivas; Nambigari, Navaneetha; K, Venugopal Reddy; Sirasani, Satyanarayana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钴(III)多吡啶配合物与DNA的嵌插结合、光裂解及抗菌活性，含分子对接但核心为化学合成与实验表征，非TF-DNA体系且AI/物理模拟方法深度不足。
abstract: A new ligand FIPB = 5-(1H-imidazo[4,5-f][1,10]phenanthrolin-2-yl)furan-2-yl-2-boronic acid, having three cobalt(III) polypyridyl complexes [Co(phen)(2)(FIPB)](3+)(1) FIPB = 5-(1H-imidazo[4,5-f][1,10]phenanthrolin-2-yl)furan-2-yl-2-boronic acid, (phen = 1,10-Phenanthroline), [Co(bpy)(2)(FIPB)](3+)(2) (bpy = 2,2'bipyridyl), [Co(dmb)(2)(FIPB)](3+)(3) (dmb = 4, 4'-dimethyl 2, 2'-bipyridine) have been synthesized and characterized by elemental analysis, ES-MS,(1)H-NMR, (13)C-NMR, UV-Vis and FTIR. Their DNA binding behavior has been explored by various spectroscopic titrations and viscosity measurements, which indicated that all the complexes bind to calf thymus DNA by means of intercalation with different binding strengths. The binding properties of these all three complexes towards calf-thymus DNA (CT-DNA) have been investigated by UV-visible, emission spectroscopy and viscosity measurements.The experimental results suggested that three Co(III) complexes can intercalate into DNA base pairs,but with different binding affinities. Photo induced DNA cleavage studies have been performed and results indicate that three complexes efficiently cleave the pBR322-DNA in different forms. The three synthesized compounds were tested for antimicrobial activity by using Staphylococcus aureus and Bacillus subtilis organisms, these results indicated that complex 1 was more activity compared to other two complexes against both tested microbial strains. The in vitro cytotoxicity of these complexes was evaluatedby MTT assay, and complex 1 shows higher cytotoxicity than complex 2 and 3 on HeLa cells.
abstract_zh: 新配体FIPB = 5-(1H-咪唑并[4,5-f][1,10]菲咯啉-2-基)呋喃-2-基-2-硼酸，及其三种钴(III)多吡啶配合物[Co(phen)₂(FIPB)]³⁺(1)（FIPB = 5-(1H-咪唑并[4,5-f][1,10]菲咯啉-2-基)呋喃-2-基-2-硼酸，phen = 1,10-菲咯啉）、[Co(bpy)₂(FIPB)]³⁺(2)（bpy = 2,2'-联吡啶）、[Co(dmb)₂(FIPB)]³⁺(3)（dmb = 4,4'-二甲基-2,2'-联吡啶）已被合成，并通过元素分析、电喷雾质谱（ES-MS）、¹H-NMR、¹³C-NMR、紫外-可见光谱（UV-Vis）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）进行表征。通过多种光谱滴定和粘度测量探索了它们的DNA结合行为，结果表明所有配合物以嵌入方式与小牛胸腺DNA结合，但结合强度不同。这三种配合物对小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的结合性质已通过紫外-可见光谱、发射光谱和粘度测量进行研究。实验结果表明，三种Co(III)配合物能嵌入DNA碱基对中，但结合亲和力不同。光诱导DNA裂解研究表明，三种配合物能以不同形式有效裂解pBR322-DNA。合成的三种化合物通过金黄色葡萄球菌和枯草芽孢杆菌进行了抗菌活性测试，结果表明配合物1对两种测试菌株的活性均高于其他两种配合物。通过MTT法评估了这些配合物的体外细胞毒性，配合物1对HeLa细胞的细胞毒性高于配合物2和3。
